package ui

import "github.com/egoist/mygo/internal/text"

// OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions selects fractional advances for this element
// and its descendants on Linux only. The default and other platforms are
// unchanged. It does not disable hint metrics, change fonts or scale painting.
// An explicit false overrides an inherited true. Pango <1.44 fails closed.
func (e Element) OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions(enabled bool) Element {
	n := e.node()
	if n == nil {
		return Element{}
	}
	n.ts.orbitFractional = enabled
	n.ts.set |= setOrbitFractional
	return e
}

// MeasureTextOrbitFractional measures the same per-layout policy used by
// OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions(true); unlike a Span property this applies to
// the whole layout including all rich-text runs. Other platforms are unchanged.
func (c *Context) MeasureTextOrbitFractional(width float32, spans ...Span) (float32, float32) {
	ctx := c.build()
	if ctx == nil {
		return 0, 0
	}
	p := ctx.rt.richParams(width, spans)
	p.Style.OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions = true
	l := ctx.rt.text.Layout(p)
	return l.Width, l.Height
}

// OrbitFractionalGlyphPositionsAvailable lets an app check the pinned native
// capability before opting any layout in. It does not enable a global policy.
func OrbitFractionalGlyphPositionsAvailable() bool {
	return text.Shared().OrbitFractionalGlyphPositionsAvailable()
}
